violation_type.title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found that the caregiver in charge did not have the proper authority and resources to direct the center in compliance with minimum standards due to the caregiver not being able to adequately maintain supervision, ratio, and caregiver responsibilities in the in the infant room and assist with director responsibilities and inspection needs at the same time.

finding_variants.text: It was found that the caregiver in charge did not have the proper authority and resources to direct the center in compliance with minimum standards due to the caregiver not being able to adequately maintain supervision, ratio, and caregiver responsibilities in the in the infant room and assist with director responsibilities and inspection needs at the same time.

Based on the information obtained from the DFPS investigation, a caregiver in charge when the director not present did not meet their task required when additional information requested for the investigation was not provided timely. It is also confirmed  that parents were having difficulties reaching out to the operation when the director is out of office.
Caregiver in charge was unable to operate in compliance without access to medications.

During an inspection, the person in charge did not ensure that ratios were maintained and that safe sleep practices were being followed. The person in charge also did not have access to the records required for the plan of action review.
The person in charge did not have access to all personnel records that were requested by CCR.
During an inspection, the person in charge did not have access to the personnel files.
